name: Carmine Gabriele Fiorillo
bioAdditions: This Carmine is known only through his sons' death records. Domenico (b. c.1775 at Cannovali, Aiello Calabro, d. 1849) and Francesco (b. c.1789, d. 1853) are both called sons of the late Carmine Gabriele Fiorillo and of a Giacinta ('Cintia'), whose surname is variously given as Feraculo, Iera and Marrello (S1, S2). Carmine's wife, missing from the tree, was therefore Giacinta. The tree's death date of 22 November 1797 and his parentage (Domenico G. Fiorillo and Cecilia Fata) presumably come from Aiello Calabro registers, which are not indexed here.

relationships.evidence: Sons' death records name wife Giacinta (surname uncertain)

openQuestionsNew: Wife Giacinta: surname Feraco/Iera/Marrello? Check Aiello Calabro (Cannovali) parish records for Domenico's baptism c.1775.
